Kiwix tools ===========

The Kiwix tools is a collection of [Kiwix](https://kiwix.org) related command line tools: * kiwix-manage: Manage XML based library of ZIM files * kiwix-search: Full text search in ZIM files * kiwix-serve: HTTP daemon serving ZIM files
